column1: # Species recovered from an unannotated (or absent) assembly, one per line.
# mode   genome = the taxon has an assembly; miniprot finds the gene directly.
#          reads = the taxon has NO assembly; the locus is reconstructed from WGS
#                  reads against the scaffold species (see RUNS in params.sh).
#          scaffold = reference species: has an assembly AND an annotation. Used
#                  as the mapping scaffold for the reads route and as the
#                  independent check on the pipeline. Not itself a target.
